podcast.body: On February 26, 1987, The Beatles, who had been hesitant to embrace the CD format, released their first four albums on compact disc. This was considered a significant milestone, as their endorsement signaled the format's widespread acceptance and validation. "And in February 26, 1987, the Beatles, who had been holding out waiting to see if the CD was worth their time, issued their first four albums on CD. Now this was a milestone because if the Beatles were going to give their blessing to this new format, well, then we definitely have a thing going on."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Rise and Fall of the CD
